title: Evaluating utility of clinical prediction models: A comparison of decision curve analysis and cost curves
abstract: arXiv:2509.24608v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classification models typically predict a binary outcome and use one or more decision thresholds to produce a classification or inform a clinical decision. Decision curves and cost curves are model evaluation approaches that assess net benefit and loss across decision thresholds. In this paper we compare decision curves and cost curves, demonstrating that decision curves are closely related to a specific type of cost curve called a Brier curve. Users of both approaches set the classification threshold assuming calibrated model scores, using the relative clinical importance of correct positive and negative classifications. A given decision curve has a corresponding Brier curve such that reference lines common in each space can be included in either (e.g. the 'treat none' decision curve can be translated into an equivalent 'treat none' Brier curve). We suggest the upper envelope decision curve as a useful comparison to a model decision

translated_title: 评估临床预测模型的效用：决策曲线分析与成本曲线的比较
translated_abstract: 分类模型通常预测二元结果，并使用一个或多个决策阈值来产生分类结果或为临床决策提供信息。决策曲线和成本曲线是评估模型在不同决策阈值下净收益和损失的模型评价方法。本文对决策曲线和成本曲线进行了比较，证明了决策曲线与一种特定类型的成本曲线——Brier曲线密切相关。使用这两种方法的用户都在假设模型分数已经过校准的前提下设置分类阈值，并依据正确阳性分类与正确阴性分类的相对临床重要性进行权衡。给定的决策曲线都存在一条与之对应的Brier曲线，使得每种空间中常见的参考线可以被纳入另一种空间中（例如，“不治疗”决策曲线可以转换为等效的“不治疗”Brier曲线）。我们建议将上包络决策曲线作为与模型决策曲线进行比较的有用基准。
tldr: 本文比较了临床预测模型评估中的决策曲线分析与成本曲线两种方法，证明决策曲线与Brier曲线密切相关且两者间的参考线可相互转换，并提出上包络决策曲线可作为模型决策曲线的有用比较基准。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that decision curves are closely related to Brier curves, a specific type of cost curve, with reference lines translatable between the two approaches, and proposes the upper envelope decision curve as a useful comparison benchmark for evaluating clinical prediction models.
